items.name: Harness Dashboard
items.tagline: Token usage across your AI coding tools, in one local app.
items.description: Reads the sessions Claude Code, Codex, OMP, PI and other agents write to disk and shows cost, tokens, plan limits and budgets. The app reads it through its local, read-only MCP server.
notes: Data comes from the local process `harness-dashboard mcp`; nothing is sent over the network.
Run `harness-dashboard` now and then so its database stays current.

items.name: Harness Memory
items.tagline: One project memory for every coding agent, kept on this machine.
items.description: A local MCP server that keeps notes and how they relate per project, so what one agent learns the next one finds. The app registers it with each detected harness while Project memory is on, and adds matching notes to the first message of a new chat.
notes: Runs locally as `harness-memory mcp`; nothing is sent over the network.
Turn it on or off for every harness in Settings, under Project memory.

items.name: Harness Skills
items.tagline: From a natural-language request to reviewed, verified work.
items.description: Owned `us-*` skills for development, focused audits, delivery and project memory, installed as an OMP plugin.
notes: Restart OMP after installing or updating.

items.name: Harness Sidebar
items.tagline: Live token charts and persistent session history for OMP in a tmux sidebar.
items.description: Shows live token charts and the session history next to OMP in tmux, and in a native pane for Claude Code.
notes: Needs tmux for the OMP sidebar.
